final: WITH profile_stats AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile) SELECT weathprofile, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, avg_bandwidth_usage - (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) FROM profile_stats) AS difference_from_mean FROM profile_stats WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) FROM profile_stats) IS NOT NULL
